notes.title: Version 1.11 released
notes.notes:
1.11 released fixing the following bugs.


Game breaking bug where if you saved at 1 certain point in the game and quit, it did not save the player status and prevented progress.
Hidden achievement that should trigger after the end sequence played moved to the start of the end sequence to fix a rare bug where it would not trigger.
Also makes sure the player gets the achievement if they quit during the end sequence.
Moved the game completion achievement to the start of the end sequence for the same reason.

notes.title: Version 1.010
notes.notes:
New version uploaded.

Patch Notes:-


.Re done the define keys and start button to avoide issue if you define pickup as D.
.Graphical glitch fixed in bird room.
.New NPC added in hidden area.
.Added bubbles to the broken bridge room.
.Slightly increased snow density.
.Added a hint for a coin that can easilly be missed.
.Relocated a coin from a secret room to a more visible area.
.Added a further clue to an early lever puzzle.
.Added a clue for a difficult to find smiley face.
.Changed colour of the "clump of cloud" object to make it more visible.
.Fixed a bug with the ghost in the temple.

notes.title: Version 1.002
notes.notes:
Very small update to address a bug that was reported.
It allowed you to bypass a cartain puzzle if you were playing on a joypad.
It did not halt progress, quite the opposite actually.
It allowed quicker progression.
Fixed in this build.

notes.title: Version 1.001
notes.notes:
Small update to solve a bug where if you complete a series of events in a certain order, it can cause a bug where you can not trigger the end sequence.

Thanks very much for reporting issues directly to me and not slamming the game in the reviews.

Means a lot to a tiny independent publisher where every review counts, truly!
I really appreciate the support and being given the chance to resolve issues.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Tiny hotfix deployed to resolve a graphical issue where the Xbox Y button was still visible when there was no save file to load.
